description: Same-day correction of the A=4 stage-1/stage-1.5 probes: the GP-kernel presentation identity is measured (GP variable v = √q; evaluating at q computes the paper trace at q²) and the full operator dictionary is certified end-to-end against the certified combiner traces (p, n, D, 4He). Canonical seam structure read off the builder: one pair-typed crossing per seam at generators {2,5,8}. Stage-1/1.5 headline residuals (14.7%, 3.8%) are void.

q_pin.note: q_parameter is anchor-adaptive (q0_anchor_manifest.json): ideal_muon producers resolve this value; ad-hoc shells resolve the proton pin — an 8.8e-8-level trap for reproduction scripts. Stage-1/1.5's hardcoded muon string agreed to ~1e-17 (pin was NOT their error; the presentation was).

presentation.gp_variable: v with generator eigenvalues (v², −v⁻²); paper q = v²

canonical_4he_structure.note: nucleon blocks are the canonical 11-crossing operator words, NOT plain Borromean [σ₁σ₂⁻¹]³; stage-1/1.5's constituent product and its {3,6,9} seam placement were therefore also wrong

verdict: SAME-DAY CORRECTION of A=4 stage 1/1.5: both probes evaluated GP Laurent characters at q₀ where the GP variable is √q (generator eigenvalues (v², −v⁻²) = paper (q, −q⁻¹) at q = v²) — so the published 14.7% / 3.8% residuals are VOID as paper-convention quantities, and their 'woven-structure 3.8%' interpretation is retracted. Convention now measured and certified: GP(√q) ≡ seminormal(q) exactly (50-digit match, plain word) and the full operator dictionary (σ; σ⁻¹ = σ−h; averaged = (σ+σ⁻¹)/2 via GP sign 0 ÷2; color-weighted aσ+bσ⁻¹) reproduces the certified combiner traces for proton, neutron, deuteron, ⁴He end-to-end through GP at the canonical-muon pin. The canonical ⁴He binding structure needs no fingerprint search — it is explicit in atom_braid_word_3A: one inter-nucleon crossing per adjacent seam at generators {2,5,8} (0-based), pair-typed (p-p: σ; p-n: color-weighted average; n-n: σ⁻¹), joining four canonical 11-crossing nucleon blocks. Stage-2 (per-block PSD + operator-selection LP) remains the open, non-tautological question. Scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired.
scope: (a) — convention correction + certification; stage-2 PSD/LP still open
